idee_recherchee.texte: At the centre of a black hole, the equations of general relativity break down into a singularity of infinite density, which shows that our current theories cannot fully describe what happens at extreme gravity.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: La singularité : où la physique cesse de fonctionner
resume: The singularity is the center of the black hole where matter is crushed to infinite density, the final destination of anything crossing the event horizon, and it is unclear whether it is physical or only mathematical. Close to it our understanding of physics breaks down, relativity may stop and unknown quantum effects take over, so nobody knows what happens there.
texte: Then there is the singularity. This is the very center of the black hole where matter is crushed to the point [music] of infinite density. The singularity will be the final point where matter that passes the event horizon ends up. It's unclear if a black hole's singularity is a physical structure [music] or just a mathematical one. The closer you get to singularity, the more our conventional understanding of physics breaks down. It's believed that [music] at a certain distance from the singularity, relativity stops altogether and unknown quantum effects take over. [music] At this moment in time, there's no way to know exactly what happens at a black hole singularity, [music] but scientists are continuously trying to make sense of these incredibly strange phenomena in our universe.
